entries.name: OpenAI text-embedding-3 Embed
entries.description: Generate text embedding vectors with OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for semantic search, clustering, classification and RAG. Same model offered via two x402 gateways; pick the body/output shape that matches the chosen backend.

usage.callShape: DEFAULT backend (x402-gateway): POST JSON {"text":"<string>","model":"text-embedding-3-small"}; for batch use {"texts":["a","b"],"model":...}. ALTERNATE backend (orthogonal, https://x402.orth.sh/openai/embeddings): OpenAI-native body {"input":"<string or array>","model":"text-embedding-3-small"} (optional encoding_format, dimensions, user). The two gateways are NOT body-compatible — sending OpenAI {input:...} to the railway gateway returns 400 and still charges; sending {text:...} to orth.sh will fail validation (it requires input+model).
usage.outputShape: DEFAULT backend (x402-gateway): NON-OpenAI flat shape — embedding (number[1536]) at top level, i.e. response.embedding[]; batch likely returns response.embeddings[][]. ALTERNATE backend (orthogonal): standard OpenAI shape — data[].embedding (number[]), model, usage.prompt_tokens, usage.total_tokens (it proxies to api.openai.com/v1/embeddings).
quirks: FIELD-NAME TRAP differs per backend: x402-gateway uses 'text' (single string) or 'texts' (array) and REJECTS the OpenAI 'input' field; orthogonal uses the OpenAI 'input' field. Pick the body shape for the backend you actually call.
x402-gateway: sending {input:...} returns HTTP 400 'Provide text (string) or texts (array of strings)' AND still charges you $0.001.

OUTPUT shape differs per backend: x402-gateway returns {embedding:[...]} at top level (NOT OpenAI's {data:[{embedding}]}). orthogonal returns the real OpenAI envelope {data:[{embedding,index}],model,usage}.
x402-gateway verified live returns a 1536-dimension float vector for text-embedding-3-small.
Pricing: x402-gateway $0.001 (x402 v2), orthogonal $0.003 (x402 v1). Default to the cheaper railway gateway unless you need the OpenAI-native envelope/'input' field.
x402-gateway accepts USDC on Base (eip155:8453), USDm (eip155:4326), and Solana USDC. orthogonal accepts USDC on Base only (x402 v1).
Pass 'dimensions' to reduce vector size (text-embedding-3 only); supported on the orthogonal/OpenAI body, default model text-embedding-3-small.
usage.guide: Generate text embedding vectors with OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for semantic search, clustering, classification and RAG. Same model offered via two x402 gateways; pick the body/output shape that matches the chosen backend. DEFAULT backend (x402-gateway): POST JSON {"text":"<string>","model":"text-embedding-3-small"}; for batch use {"texts":["a","b"],"model":...}. ALTERNATE backend (orthogonal, https://x402.orth.sh/openai/embeddings): OpenAI-native body {"input":"<string or array>","model":"text-embedding-3-small"} (optional encoding_format, dimensions, user). The two gateways are NOT body-compatible — sending OpenAI {input:...} to the railway gateway returns 400 and still charges; sending {text:...} to orth.sh will fail validation (it requires input+model). Output: DEFAULT backend (x402-gateway): NON-OpenAI flat shape — embedding (number[1536]) at top level, i.e. response.embedding[]; batch likely returns response.embeddings[][]. entries.name: Bittensor Embeddings
entries.description: Text embeddings served via the Bittensor decentralized AI network through the Spraay gateway, billed per call via x402 (and MPP) using USDC on Base or Solana.

usage.callShape: POST https://gateway.spraay.app/bittensor/v1/embeddings with JSON body {model, input} (OpenAI-compatible embeddings)
usage.outputShape: Intended: body.data[].embedding (OpenAI embeddings shape). Not observed — endpoint returned body.error.message instead.
quirks: NEEDS-REVIEW (not dropped): failure looks transient (host down / upstream 502) as of 2026-06-08 — re-test before relying on it. MONEY-RISK if it charges-then-fails.
Charge-then-fail: gateway accepts x402 payment ($0.005) then returns HTTP 502 with body.error.code=provider_error and message 'Embeddings error: Chutes AI returned 404'.
The Spraay gateway's upstream provider (Chutes AI) embeddings route is dead (returns 404 HTML).
Failure is identical for both bare ('bge-large-en-v1.5') and HF-namespaced ('BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5') model names, so it is NOT a model-name problem — the upstream route is broken.
Unpaid pre-flight shows 402 (looks payable) but the endpoint does not actually deliver embeddings. Do NOT retry — money is lost per attempt.
usage.guide: This endpoint is currently broken. It is an OpenAI-compatible embeddings API (POST with {model, input}) on the Spraay gateway, but it charges $0.005 via x402 and then returns HTTP 502 because its upstream Chutes AI embeddings route returns 404. Do not call it — payment is taken with no result. If revisiting, confirm the gateway's upstream is restored before paying.

entries.name: Text Embeddings
entries.description: Vector embeddings for input text, gated by a per-call x402 micropayment (USDC on Base or SPL tokens on Solana) via the PaySponge gateway.

usage.outputShape: body.data[].embedding (array of floats); body.object="list", each item body.data[i].object="embedding" with .index. OpenAI-compatible.
quirks: inputSchema in the registry is EMPTY but the endpoint REQUIRES a 'model' string field — sending only {input} returns HTTP 400 with a zod error: 'expected string, received undefined' at path [model] (you still get charged $0.01 for the failed call).
Use 'model':'text-embedding-3-small' (OpenAI model name) — accepted and produces a valid embedding.
'input' holds the text to embed (string).
Output is OpenAI-compatible: result vector is at body.data[0].embedding.
usage.guide: POST a JSON body {"model":"text-embedding-3-small","input":"<your text>"} to the URL; payment is x402 USDC (~$0.01, Base or Solana), no API key needed. The 'model' field is mandatory even though the registry schema lists no fields — omitting it returns a 400 and still costs you a call. Read the embedding vector from body.data[0].embedding; the response mirrors the OpenAI embeddings format ({object:"list", data:[{object:"embedding", embedding:[...], index}]}).

entries.name: Venice Embeddings
entries.description: Embeds 1-100 strings into semantic vectors using Venice-hosted models (Google gemini-embedding-2-preview, BGE-M3, or OpenAI text-embedding-3-small), returning float vectors aligned with input order.

usage.outputShape: body.embeddings (array of float vectors aligned with input order), body.count, body.dimensions, body.model, body.usage
quirks: Registry lists method GET, but that is WRONG. A GET on the URL just returns a discovery/schema doc (HTTP 200 with name/description/input_schema/price) — it does NOT embed anything and is not the paid call. The real call is POST.

Pay with POST and a JSON body {texts:[...], model}. 'texts' is required (1-100 strings, each up to 30000 chars). 'model' is optional: 'default' (gemini-embedding-2-preview, recommended), 'fast' (BGE-M3), 'openai-compat' (text-embedding-3-small), or a full Venice model name.
Flat price $0.002 per call regardless of how many strings (registry priceDisplay 'Varies' is misleading).
Result vectors are in body.embeddings and aligned with input order; default model returns 1024 dimensions.
BROKEN 2026-06-11: 404 — endpoint dead (POST returns 404).
usage.guide: Send a POST (not GET) to https://x402-deployer.x402-deployer.workers.dev/text-embedding with JSON body {"texts":["sentence one","sentence two"],"model":"default"}; x402 USDC payment of $0.002 on Base is required per call. The embedding vectors come back in body.embeddings as an array of float arrays in the same order as the input texts, with body.dimensions and body.model describing them. A plain GET on the URL only returns the schema/discovery doc, so always POST to actually embed.
